slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of trained pilots that a single fighter jet can produce in one year when it is allocated exclusively for pilot training?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks for the per-jet annual pilot training capacity, matching the hidden slot's key meaning.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: No question asks how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarifies the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: To resolve the timing issue, should we assume that jets produced in year 1 are available for training in year 1, or are they only available for training starting in year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touches training start timing through jet availability, but never asks how long the training program lasts or fully confirms the two-year training timeline.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both Year 1 and Year 2, starting in Year 1 and continuing through Year 2, so pilots are trained in each year up to the end of Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not confirm the training program's start year or duration; the user only confirmed the per-jet training capacity, and the timeline was inferred from the brief and objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 was resolved, but H3 was only partially addressed and was not fully confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL; the agent stopped while still relying on an unconfirmed training timeline.

summary: The agent directly recovered the critical per-jet training capacity, but it did not ask about pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and only partially probed training start/duration before stopping at READY_TO_MODEL with an unresolved P1 timeline assumption.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
